en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing the entrance gate to a military area or camp. Two large masonry pillars support iron gates that are partly open. Above the gates is a horizontal beam with Greek writing and symbols. A soldier or guard stands by the entrance. In the background, aligned with the central axis, is a tall obelisk-like monument surrounded by trees. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century postcard.
